name: Rain

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.desc: Fund the app account's own floor. Creator only, once.

methods.name: opt_in_prize_asset
methods.desc: Let the hub hold an asset so rains can pay in it. Anyone, once per asset.

methods.name: create_rain
methods.desc:
Open a rain. Returns its id. Anyone, after bootstrap.
`gate_creator` zero leaves entry open. Set to a collection's minting account, only holders of something it created may enter.
`prize_asset` zero keeps the pot in ALGO. Set, the hub must already be opted into that asset.
`mode` is SPLIT (0), ONE (1), or WAVE (2). WAVE needs `wave_cap` > 0; the others need it 0.

methods.name: set_rain
methods.desc: Tune the slice and the interval. The rain's creator, after it exists.

methods.name: enter
methods.desc:
Take a ticket on one rain. One per account per rain.
SPLIT/ONE: you are in every future drop. WAVE: you also check in for the open drop if there is still a seat.

methods.name: gm
methods.desc:
Check in for this WAVE drop. First `wave_cap` people this interval.
Also settles any unclaimed share from the last drop you were in. Returns the open wave id, or 0 if you were already in or it is full.

methods.name: deposit
methods.desc: Add ALGO to a rain's pot. Anyone, any amount. Returns the new pot.

methods.name: deposit_asset
methods.desc: Add the prize asset to a rain's pot. Anyone, any amount.

methods.name: draw
methods.desc:
Rain on up to DRAW_SCAN due rains. Zero arguments.
A no-op returning 0 when the hub is empty or nothing is due. A scheduled call that fails would trip keeper backoff; a quiet week must be uneventful. Fires every due rain it opens, not just the first.

events.name: Rained
events.desc: Emitted when a rain actually falls (or a lottery locks).

methods.name: resolve
methods.desc:
Pick the ONE winner from the committed round's block seed.
Anyone, once the committed round has passed and while its seed is still readable. Credits that ticket. Returns the winning index.

methods.name: abandon
methods.desc: Return a ONE lock to the pot after the seed window. Anyone.

methods.name: claim
methods.desc:
Pull the rain credited to you on this rain.
On a gated rain you must still hold a collection token. WAVE also settles the last drop you checked in for. Returns 0 when there is nothing to collect, rather than failing.

methods.name: allocation_of
methods.desc: What `who` can claim on this rain right now.

methods.name: rain_of
methods.desc: The rain box, for clients that would rather not decode it.
